source: Actual five-city original-MPC development SUMO episodes, seed41002; cached identical trajectories excluded to avoid duplicate examples
target: Network inbound stopped queue five actual simulation seconds after a causal observed state
features: Current queues, counts, capacities, arrivals, starvation, lamp execution/phase summaries, time and network size; no future state
evaluation: Rotate all five cities, fit exclusively on transitions from the other four and predict all held-out-city transitions; no test tuning
scope: Observed original-MPC policy dynamics only; unvalidated for counterfactual signal plans. Actual SUMO remains the benchmark truth.
timing: 100 repeated whole-held-out-transition batches, features+model forward only; separate actual episode cost includes initialization, TraCI, physics and traces. These unequal scopes are not a simulator-replacement speedup.
